vehicle_variant.native_axes: metres; Z up; -Y forward; +X driver side
vehicle_variant.coordinate_mapping_verified: Unity XYZ=(-BlenderX,BlenderZ,-BlenderY), checked against imported empties
vehicle_variant.variant_changes: Actual driver aperture and hinged original door; bounded cabin floor clearance; low sports seat; authored footwell/steering; roof and matching door upper frame smoothly raised by up to 90mm; lower 280mm sill.
vehicle_variant.headroom_revision: Additional smooth 120mm high-roof/window-frame reprofile; native original preserved.
vehicle_variant.hinge_revision: Outboard front-edge pivot (.89,-1.18,.77) preserving closed geometry; 4mm lower-edge and 3mm rear-edge seam clearance.
vehicle_variant.unity_exact_import_status: PASS: same final FBX SHA256, imported hinge (-.89,.77,1.18), identical exact Noob CPU streams, sampled separate door curves pass.
